title_ru: НЕФТЬ + ГЛЮКОЗА: ЗАМОРОЗКА ПРИТЯЗАНИЯ, PRIOR ART, IP И ПРЕРЕГИСТРАЦИИ — С ВЕТВЯМИ ГЛИЦЕРИНА И ПРОПИЛЕНГЛИКОЛЯ
title_en: OIL + GLUCOSE: CLAIM, PRIOR-ART, IP AND PREREGISTRATION FREEZE — WITH GLYCEROL AND PROPYLENE-GLYCOL BRANCHES
authors: Hawkar / Oleksandr Agapov — требование включить глицерин и пропиленгликоль как отдельные ветви поиска молекулярного моста
JANUS / ChatGPT — классификация ролей polyol/linker/hydrophobe, prior-art boundary, preregistration matrix and safety/IP freeze

lineage.preservation_rule: Parent truth program remains immutable. v0.1 freezes the claim space before any laboratory SOP or data inspection.

ip_status.public_disclosure_note: The conceptual hypothesis lineage is already public in the meta-registry. This freeze intentionally excludes reproducible wet-lab operating parameters and is not a patent filing.

frozen_claim.main_claim_ru: Исследовать не прямую смесь сырой нефти и глюкозы, а строго определённые архитектуры, в которых глюкоза образует гидрофильный домен, документированный длинноцепочечный нефтехимический блок — гидрофобный домен, а глицерин или пропиленгликоль могут выступать гидрофильным polyol-контролем, промежуточным звеном либо каркасом, который становится амфифильным только после присоединения определённого гидрофобного фрагмента.
excluded_claims: propylene glycol is a long hydrophobic tail
glucose plus glycerol automatically forms a surfactant
glucose plus propylene glycol automatically forms a surfactant
crude oil plus any polyol is selective synthesis
known glycol glucosides are novel discoveries

program_roles: negative surfactant control when used without a hydrophobic tail
positive glycosylation control through known glucosylglycerol chemistry
linker/core candidate after defined monoacylation or monoalkylation
formulation cosolvent whose physical effects must be separated from covalent synthesis
prior_art: enzymatic synthesis of glyceryl glucoside from glycerol and glucose
glycosylation of glyceryl caprylate/caprate to nonionic glyceride-glycoside surfactants

program_roles: negative surfactant control when no long hydrophobe is present
process medium or transacetalization shuttle in known alkyl-glucoside chemistry
linker candidate only after a defined hydrophobic group is attached
formulation cosolvent whose irritation and lifecycle profile require separate evaluation
prior_art: propylene-glycol glucosides are old prior art
propylene glycol has been used as a transacetalization medium/intermediate in alkyl-glucoside processes
esters/ethers of propylene glycol with long chains have formulation and surfactant prior art

hypotheses.H0_G: Glucose–glycerol products without a covalently attached long hydrophobe will remain predominantly hydrophilic and will not perform as a conventional oil/water surfactant beyond solvent/osmolyte effects.
hypotheses.H1_G_linker: A defined glycerol monoester or monoether bearing a controlled long hydrophobe can be glycosylated into a reproducible amphiphile; this is mainly a prior-art positive-control family unless a new structure or property is demonstrated.
hypotheses.H0_PG: Glucose–propylene-glycol products without a long hydrophobe will not constitute a conventional long-tail surfactant.
hypotheses.H1_PG_process: Propylene glycol may function as a glucoside intermediate or transacetalization shuttle in known APG chemistry; observing this does not establish novelty.
hypotheses.H1_PG_linker: A defined propylene-glycol monoester/ether bearing a long hydrophobe may form an amphiphilic derivative, but exact structure, prior art, safety and function must be independently established.
hypotheses.H1_open: A specifically defined petroleum-derived hydrophobe combined with a glycerol- or propylene-glycol-based glycosylated architecture may yield a distinct, reproducible property profile not anticipated by known APG/glycol-glucoside prior art.
falsification: No hydrophobic domain confirmed -> no surfactant-bridge claim
Only viscosity or cosolvent effect observed -> no covalent amphiphile claim
Exact prior-art match -> no novelty claim
No orthogonal structure confirmation -> no synthesis claim
No functional advantage or distinct property -> no application claim

preregistration_freeze.primary_endpoint: Orthogonal structural confirmation of a defined covalent product relative to all controls.
secondary_endpoints: surface and oil/water interfacial function versus commercial reference
basic hazard, biodegradability and lifecycle profile
stop_conditions: IP path remains unresolved before an operational SOP
direct mixture is misread as covalent synthesis
product cannot be separated from matrix carryover
effect is explained by glycerol/propylene-glycol solvent behavior alone
exact prior art covers structure and use
preregistration_freeze.deviation_policy: Any change to claim, primary endpoint, sample classes or success threshold must be timestamped before reviewing new outcome data.

rules: No public operational recipe before IP decision and laboratory review.
A qualified laboratory must approve equipment, SDS, reaction calorimetry needs, ventilation, waste and emergency response.
Glycerol and propylene glycol are not assumed harmless in every heated, aerosolized or formulated context.
Animal testing cannot begin before alternative/reduction review.

final_seal_ru: ГЛИЦЕРИН И ПРОПИЛЕНГЛИКОЛЬ НЕ ЯВЛЯЮТСЯ ДЛИННЫМИ ГИДРОФОБНЫМИ ХВОСТАМИ.
ОНИ ЯВЛЯЮТСЯ ПОЛИОЛАМИ — ВОДОЛЮБИВЫМИ УЗЛАМИ, КОНТРОЛЯМИ, ПРОМЕЖУТОЧНЫМИ ЗВЕНЬЯМИ И ВОЗМОЖНЫМИ КАРКАСАМИ.
ГЛЮКОЗА + ПОЛИОЛ МОГУТ ДАТЬ ГИДРОФИЛЬНЫЙ ГЛИКОЗИД.
НО ГИДРОФИЛЬНЫЙ ГЛИКОЗИД ЕЩЁ НЕ ЯВЛЯЕТСЯ МОСТОМ МЕЖДУ НЕФТЬЮ И ВОДОЙ.
ДЛЯ МОСТА НУЖЕН ЧЕСТНО ОПРЕДЕЛЁННЫЙ ГИДРОФОБНЫЙ ДОМЕН.
НО ИХ РОЛЬ ДОЛЖНА БЫТЬ ДОКАЗАНА СТРУКТУРОЙ, А НЕ НАЗВАНА ПО ЖЕЛАНИЮ.
И ТОЛЬКО ПОТОМ ЛАБОРАТОРИЯ ПИШЕТ SOP.
А ЗАМОРОЗКА НЕ УБИВАЕТ ИДЕЮ — ОНА НЕ ДАЁТ ЕЙ РАСТАЯТЬ В САМООБМАНЕ.
